settings.title: What is this for?
settings.content: This lead wire is intended to replace or serve as a backup for the original lead wire that comes with the MyoLift Ultra device. It facilitates the connection between the device and its applicator probes, enabling effective microcurrent facial treatments.

settings.title: How To Use
settings.content:
1. Connect to Device: Insert the 2-pin end of the lead wire into the 5-pin, 2-core round socket on the MyoLift Ultra device.Pinterest+27E Wellness+27E Wellness+2
  2. Attach Applicator Probes: Connect the appropriate applicator probes to the other end of the lead wire.
  3. Ensure Secure Connection: Verify that all connections are secure before initiating treatment.

settings.title: Benefits
settings.content:
• Reliable Connection: Ensures consistent and effective microcurrent delivery during treatments.
  • Convenience: Serves as a replacement or backup, minimizing downtime in case of damage or loss of the original lead wire.
  • Ease of Use: Simple to connect and disconnect, facilitating seamless integration into your skincare routine.

settings.title: Product Features
settings.content:
• Compatibility: Designed specifically for the MyoLift Ultra device.
  • Connection Type: 2-pin open lead wire compatible with 5-pin, 2-core round sockets.
